releases.statement: Two of the greatest rivals in gaming history now share one wall. The Super Nintendo brings the golden age of the console wars, the Nintendo 64 the leap into three dimensions that changed games forever, and Sega the consoles that dared to take Nintendo on. And for the first time, CrystalWorlds.Media remembers your games with you: what you're playing, what you've finished, and every achievement you've earned along the way.
This release is all about feel. Everything you reach for is easier to find and easier to understand, and the Atari consoles now glow with the colours their makers intended.
We set out to build the most faithful Game Boy we could. Now anyone in the world can put it to the test.
Your vault is now the heart of CrystalWorlds.Media. One key opens everything you own, wherever you are, and every Game Boy ever made is waiting inside.
The best Game Boy we've ever made, and more of the NES library brought back to life than ever before. Plus a beautiful new look for screens that go truly black.

This is the beginning. Your films, your shows and the games that shaped a generation, together in one place and alive in your browser, on emulators we built from the ground up so this history is never lost.
